clips.title: The story
paras: Outlaws hold Durnholde Keep, a shattered fortress east of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Once the Alliance headquarters for the southern orc internment camps, it is now a Syndicate refuge.

After the Second War, the Alliance made Durnholde Keep its headquarters for the southern internment camps. Lieutenant General Aedelas Blackmoore commanded the fortress and its arena, where orcs fought for sport and profit. Blackmoore raised the orphaned infant Go'el as a slave, named him Thrall, and trained him to fight. With Taretha Foxton's aid, Thrall escaped captivity and later united the scattered orc clans beneath the new Horde. He returned to Durnholde, besieged the keep, slew Blackmoore, and called on the earth spirits to shatter its walls.

Durnholde Keep has lain in ruins since its collapse before the Third War. After Lordaeron fell, the Syndicate took refuge among its broken ramparts. These bandits are dispossessed Alterac nobles and cutthroats. From the ruined bailey and towers, they prey on travelers across the Hillsbrad Foothills, using the old fortress as a fortified outpost.
